conceptZh: 披風英雄的長披風自己把他往後拉，倒著飛回「昨天」，筆畫也倒著落下。
object: a caped action-figure hero with a far-too-long cape
morph: the willful cape yanks the hero backward and the strokes of 昨 fall in rewind order
creativeAngle: 道具反抗：披風決定往回走，剛好對上「昨」的倒退意思。
promptEn: An 8-second animated clip on a pale lavender background, with one single Traditional Chinese glyph 昨 as the only text on screen, drawn in rich plum solid strokes, centered, uncropped, about 70% of frame height with generous margins. 0-1.7s: a stout caped action figure strikes a hero pose and launches forward, but his crimson cape flops over his own head and he face-plants softly into a pillow cloud; the first 昨 is spoken as the right-hand 乍 strokes drop in from above. 1.7-3.4s: the cape grabs a lamp post and hauls him backward in a comic reverse-flight, legs pedaling; second 昨 as the left 日 slides in from the left like a rewinding film. 3.4-5s: 昨天 is spoken as the hero outsmarts the cape by tying it into a knot and a flutter of calendar pages (shapes only, no digits) blows backward behind him. 5-8s: hold; the hero stands, cape tidily knotted, giving a thumbs-up away from the glyph. Audio: a warm off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin reads exactly "昨、昨、昨天" (ㄗㄨㄛˊ、ㄗㄨㄛˊ、ㄗㄨㄛˊ ㄊㄧㄢ), slowly and distinctly with clear tones, a short pause between the two single utterances, and stops after the word; no other speech, no subtitles, no vocabulary text. Final 3 seconds (5-8s): the glyph 昨 is perfectly still and fully readable while the lead keeps a small joyful motion away from the strokes. Bright but not neon palette, no watermark, no flashing, no other writing.
